objective: Audit necessity,redundancy and cross-patient stability of M8's7 physiological measurements; literature-guided trustworthy new features; nested selection,matched ablations,M8 integration and reproducible performance verification without test selection. A null finding must bound the studied candidate class, never claim global optimality of7D.
legal_inputs: Pinned original context FIT/validation banks; exact R14; original actual-mask Raw250/500 banks and verified window DELTA registry. No Outer score,seal,metric,prediction orfull-label archive loader is allowed in discovery code.
leakage: Each outer fold independently chooses features using only its original FIT patients. Original validation is reserved for final epoch/threshold selection, not feature search. No cross-fold global winner chosen from validation/Outer metrics. Feature extraction is label-blind,per-patient,nonlearned; materializing all80 raw patients is not supervised screening of the held-out fold.

old7_probe.classifier: LogisticRegression C1 lbfgs max_iter2000 tol1e-7; no hyperparameter search
old7_probe.views: full14; each of7 groups mean/std alone; each of7 groups removed =15 variants
old7_probe.inner_calibration: 20percent remaining patient IDs selected by deterministic random permutation seed42+1009*fold+43*screen; disjoint from subFIT and untouched screening patients
old7_probe.preprocessing: Original full-patient populationZ; FIT-only mean imputer and StandardScaler refit on inner subFIT for each variant
old7_probe.weights: patient equal times inverse pooled subFIT class frequency
old7_probe.threshold: EZ-probability0:0.005:1; inner calibration only; patient MacroF1 then EZF1 then nearest0.5 then lower
old7_probe.interpretation: Linear probes are initial conditional-utility evidence,not proof of nonlinear M8 necessity or a final feature decision.

scale_audit: Per-FIT-patient feature mean/std magnitude and original PatientZ SD<=1e-8 fallback,finite/constant coverage,Spearman pairs before/after patientZ. No labels used. RMS numerical floor1e-8 is audited against actual waveform mean square,not assumed negligible.
candidate_math: See features.py; formulas and epsilons fixed before extraction. Existing waveforms and exact2s valid windows,no new filters,resampling or source substitution; per-windowfloat64 calculations castfloat32. Baseline subtract actual same-channel pre-onset featuremean; available-window seizuremean then available-seizure mean/populationSD,feature-major mean/std. Invalid/padded entries never counted.
signal_limits: No delta/theta/full-alpha recovery because FCPA-LF fidelity gate failed. No80-150Hz HFO or PLHG claim from250Hz cache; only explicitly partial80-125Hz band. Spectral slope is a restricted-bin descriptive proxy,not a validated aperiodic/FOOOF exponent or E/I ratio. PE on early ictal windows is not published postictal PEI.
end_state_not_yet_complete: Audit old7 necessity,redundancy,direction and cross-center stability
Build,test and extract prospective candidate features with full coverage gates
NestedFIT-only screening of single/drop/add/combined features and stability
Matched nonlinear feature models and separate D1-versus-gate pathway ablations
Integrate selected original/pruned/new/combined physiology into lightweight M8
Freeze per-fold features,models,scalers,epochs,thresholds before final verification
If no candidate wins,report bounded negative results and whyoriginal7D remains defensible;not global optimality
Outer_policy: Do not access or recompute Outer in phasesA-C. A later final prospective protocol may permit exactly one frozen confirmation per final matched arm; original Outer was historically viewed,so never call it blind or independent. No external/unseen cohort currently established.
privacy: Only code,hashes and anonymous aggregates leave server. Patient/window/channel data,labels,predictions,checkpoints,caches and logs stay private. Preserve existing source and jobs. No installed research/extraction skills.
